sources.source:
grammar oracle.InheritedModelCall.Child with oracle.InheritedModelCall.Base
generate child "urn:intersect:inference:composition:inherited_model_call:child"
import "urn:intersect:inference:composition:inherited_model_call:base" as b
import "http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2002/Ecore" as ecore
Entry: 'entry' items+=Node*;

grammar oracle.InheritedCallWithoutImport.Child with oracle.InheritedCallWithoutImport.Base
generate child "urn:intersect:inference:composition:inherited_call_without_import:child"
import "http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2002/Ecore" as ecore
Entry: 'entry' items+=Node*;

grammar oracle.SealedParentNewSupertype.Child with oracle.SealedParentNewSupertype.Base
generate child "urn:intersect:inference:composition:sealed_parent_new_supertype:child"
import "urn:intersect:inference:composition:sealed_parent_new_supertype:base" as b
import "http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2002/Ecore" as ecore
Entry: Node;

grammar oracle.OverrideExplicitParentType.Child with oracle.OverrideExplicitParentType.Base
generate child "urn:intersect:inference:composition:override_explicit_parent_type:child"
import "urn:intersect:inference:composition:override_explicit_parent_type:base" as b
import "http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2002/Ecore" as ecore
Entry: 'entry' item=Node; @Override Node returns b::Node: 'item' name=ID;

grammar oracle.NewSubclassOfParent.Child with oracle.NewSubclassOfParent.Base
generate child "urn:intersect:inference:composition:new_subclass_of_parent:child"
import "urn:intersect:inference:composition:new_subclass_of_parent:base" as b
import "http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2002/Ecore" as ecore
Entry returns b::Node: {Special} 'special' name=ID;

grammar oracle.SubclassWithNewFeature.Child with oracle.SubclassWithNewFeature.Base
generate child "urn:intersect:inference:composition:subclass_with_new_feature:child"
import "urn:intersect:inference:composition:subclass_with_new_feature:base" as b
import "http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2002/Ecore" as ecore
Entry returns b::Node: {Special} 'special' name=ID extra=INT;

grammar oracle.ExplicitSuperModelCall.Child with oracle.ExplicitSuperModelCall.Base
generate child "urn:intersect:inference:composition:explicit_super_model_call:child"
import "urn:intersect:inference:composition:explicit_super_model_call:base" as b
import "http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2002/Ecore" as ecore
Entry: 'entry' item=super::Node; @Override Node returns b::Node: 'item' name=ID;

grammar oracle.InheritedEnum.Child with oracle.InheritedEnum.Base
generate child "urn:intersect:inference:composition:inherited_enum:child"
import "urn:intersect:inference:composition:inherited_enum:base" as b
import "http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2002/Ecore" as ecore
Entry: shade=Shade;

grammar oracle.OverrideImportedEnum.Child with oracle.OverrideImportedEnum.Base
generate child "urn:intersect:inference:composition:override_imported_enum:child"
import "urn:intersect:inference:composition:override_imported_enum:base" as b
import "http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2002/Ecore" as ecore
Entry: shade=Shade; @Override enum Shade returns b::Shade: RED='warm' | BLUE='cool';

grammar oracle.OverrideImportedEnumNewLiteral.Child with oracle.OverrideImportedEnumNewLiteral.Base
generate child "urn:intersect:inference:composition:override_imported_enum_new_literal:child"
import "urn:intersect:inference:composition:override_imported_enum_new_literal:base" as b
import "http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2002/Ecore" as ecore
Entry: shade=Shade; @Override enum Shade returns b::Shade: GREEN='green';

grammar oracle.OverrideTerminal.Child with oracle.OverrideTerminal.Base
generate child "urn:intersect:inference:composition:override_terminal:child"
import "urn:intersect:inference:composition:override_terminal:base" as b
import "http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2002/Ecore" as ecore
Entry: name=ID; @Override terminal ID: '@' ('a'..'z')+;

grammar oracle.OverrideTerminalTypeChange.Child with oracle.OverrideTerminalTypeChange.Base
generate child "urn:intersect:inference:composition:override_terminal_type_change:child"
import "urn:intersect:inference:composition:override_terminal_type_change:base" as b
import "http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2002/Ecore" as ecore
Entry: value=INT; @Override terminal INT returns ecore::EString: ('0'..'9')+;

grammar oracle.DuplicateGeneratedNamespace.Child with oracle.DuplicateGeneratedNamespace.Base
generate child "urn:intersect:inference:composition:duplicate_generated_namespace:base"
import "http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2002/Ecore" as ecore
Entry: name=ID;

grammar oracle.ImportOnlyChild.Child with oracle.ImportOnlyChild.Base
import "urn:intersect:inference:composition:import_only_child:base" as b
import "http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2002/Ecore" as ecore
Entry returns b::Model: 'entry' nodes+=Node*;
grammar oracle.DeclarationFreeChild.Child with oracle.DeclarationFreeChild.Base

grammar oracle.ThreeLevelGeneratedPackages.Middle with oracle.ThreeLevelGeneratedPackages.Base
generate middle "urn:intersect:inference:composition:three_level_generated_packages:middle"
import "urn:intersect:inference:composition:three_level_generated_packages:base" as b
import "http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2002/Ecore" as ecore
Part: 'part' name=ID;

grammar oracle.ThreeLevelGeneratedPackages.Child with oracle.ThreeLevelGeneratedPackages.Middle
generate child "urn:intersect:inference:composition:three_level_generated_packages:child"
import "urn:intersect:inference:composition:three_level_generated_packages:base" as b
import "http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2002/Ecore" as ecore
import "urn:intersect:inference:composition:three_level_generated_packages:middle" as m
Entry: nodes+=Node* parts+=Part*;

grammar oracle.SameShortClassifierNames.Child with oracle.SameShortClassifierNames.Base
generate child "urn:intersect:inference:composition:same_short_classifier_names:child"
import "urn:intersect:inference:composition:same_short_classifier_names:base" as b
import "http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2002/Ecore" as ecore
Entry: inherited=super::Node own=Node; Node: 'own' name=ID;

grammar oracle.SharedImportAlias.Child with oracle.SharedImportAlias.Base
generate child "urn:intersect:inference:composition:shared_import_alias:child" as c
import "urn:intersect:inference:composition:shared_import_alias:base" as c
import "http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2002/Ecore" as ecore
Entry returns c::Root: item=Node;

grammar oracle.AliasedGeneratedOnly.Child with oracle.AliasedGeneratedOnly.Base
generate child "urn:intersect:inference:composition:aliased_generated_only:child" as c
import "http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2002/Ecore" as ecore
Entry returns c::Root: item=Node;

grammar oracle.TwoParents.Child with oracle.TwoParents.Base, oracle.TwoParents.Other
generate child "urn:intersect:inference:composition:two_parents:child"
import "urn:intersect:inference:composition:two_parents:base" as b
import "http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2002/Ecore" as ecore
import "urn:intersect:inference:composition:two_parents:other" as o
Entry: item=Node part=Part;

grammar oracle.AmbiguousParentRule.Child with oracle.AmbiguousParentRule.Base, oracle.AmbiguousParentRule.Other
generate child "urn:intersect:inference:composition:ambiguous_parent_rule:child"
import "urn:intersect:inference:composition:ambiguous_parent_rule:base" as b
import "http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2002/Ecore" as ecore
import "urn:intersect:inference:composition:ambiguous_parent_rule:other" as o
Entry: item=Node;

grammar oracle.UnaliasedImportCollision.Child with oracle.UnaliasedImportCollision.Base, oracle.UnaliasedImportCollision.Other
generate child "urn:intersect:inference:composition:unaliased_import_collision:child"
import "urn:intersect:inference:composition:unaliased_import_collision:base"
import "urn:intersect:inference:composition:unaliased_import_collision:other"
import "http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2002/Ecore" as ecore
Entry: item=Node;

grammar oracle.NewCrossReferenceToParent.Child with oracle.NewCrossReferenceToParent.Base
generate child "urn:intersect:inference:composition:new_cross_reference_to_parent:child"
import "urn:intersect:inference:composition:new_cross_reference_to_parent:base" as b
import "http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2002/Ecore" as ecore
Entry: items+=Node* ('use' uses+=[b::Node|ID])*;

grammar oracle.ChildActionHierarchy.Child with oracle.ChildActionHierarchy.Base
generate child "urn:intersect:inference:composition:child_action_hierarchy:child"
import "urn:intersect:inference:composition:child_action_hierarchy:base" as b
import "http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2002/Ecore" as ecore
Entry: Node | Special; Special: {Special} 'special' name=ID;

grammar oracle.ParentImportsExternal.Child with oracle.ParentImportsExternal.Base
generate child "urn:intersect:inference:composition:parent_imports_external:child"
import "urn:intersect:inference:composition:parent_imports_external:base" as b
import "urn:intersect:inference:imported" as x
import "http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2002/Ecore" as ecore
Entry: values+=External*;

grammar oracle.ChildSubclassesOriginalImport.Child with oracle.ChildSubclassesOriginalImport.Base
generate child "urn:intersect:inference:composition:child_subclasses_original_import:child"
import "urn:intersect:inference:composition:child_subclasses_original_import:base" as b
import "urn:intersect:inference:imported" as x
import "http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2002/Ecore" as ecore
Entry returns x::External: {Special} 'special' name=ID extra=INT;

grammar oracle.SameNameImportsExplicitAliases.Child with oracle.SameNameImportsExplicitAliases.Base
generate child "urn:intersect:inference:composition:same_name_imports_explicit_aliases:child"
import "urn:intersect:inference:composition:same_name_imports_explicit_aliases:base" as b
import "urn:intersect:inference:imported" as x
import "http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2002/Ecore" as ecore
Entry: base=External original=Original; Original returns x::External: 'original' name=ID;

grammar oracle.SameNameImportsUnqualified.Child with oracle.SameNameImportsUnqualified.Base
generate child "urn:intersect:inference:composition:same_name_imports_unqualified:child"
import "urn:intersect:inference:composition:same_name_imports_unqualified:base"
import "urn:intersect:inference:imported"
import "http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2002/Ecore" as ecore
Entry returns External: 'entry' name=ID; Anchor: 'anchor' key=ID;
